import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px

# 筛选已完成订单
completed = df[df['order_status'] == '已完成'].copy()

# 提取月份并统计订单数量
completed['month'] = pd.to_datetime(completed['order_date']).dt.strftime('%Y-%m')
result = completed.groupby('month', as_index=False).size().rename(columns={'size': 'order_count'})

# 按月份升序排列
result = result.sort_values('month').reset_index(drop=True)

# 生成折线图
fig = px.line(result, x='month', y='order_count', markers=True, title='已完成订单数量月度趋势')
fig.update_layout(xaxis_title='月份', yaxis_title='订单数量')
